blocks.text: Organizers of the 2026 Seoul Race confirmed that a participant in her twenties died following a medical collapse near the finish line of Sunday’s half-marathon event. The organizing committee stated that the runner collapsed at 8:49 a.m. close to the 20.6-kilometer marker, approximately 500 meters prior to the finish line.
